findingsAddressed.title: full-test precondition allows direct retry after a failed Full Test
findingsAddressed.rootCause: The spec 'Delivery-level Action 前置条件' defined full-test as allowed when deliveryFullTestStatus != passed. Since failed != passed, failed satisfied the precondition, allowing direct full-test retry. This violated frozen verification-model.md Section 6, which requires fullTestStatus to remain failed and Policy to return an owner decision boundary or blocked diagnosis. The owner may authorize a corrective Change or cancel, and only the corrective Change resets the status to not-ready before another Full Test cycle.
findingsAddressed.fix: Restricted full-test precondition to deliveryFullTestStatus ∈ {awaiting-user-decision, authorized} (pre-execution states per frozen Section 4.2). Added blocked:full-test-failed for failed status with suggestedOwnerActions listing corrective Change or cancel Delivery (per frozen Section 6: fullTestStatus preserved, no auto-retry, no auto-create corrective Change). Added full-test-already-passed rejection for passed status. Added corrective-Change reset path scenario (fullTestStatus returns not-ready). Added design decision D1-13 with full FullTestStatus × full-test behavior matrix, blocked-vs-owner-decision distinction (per D1-9: owner has multiple choices so blocked not owner-decision), and complementarity with D1-12. Added 4 spec scenarios, 2 tasks (4.18, 10.23), updated 4.12/7.4. Updated conclusion (scratch) Section 3.2/3.3/5/9.

keyFindings: D1-PR-005 is a content defect: full-test precondition used deliveryFullTestStatus ≠ passed, which incorrectly included failed as eligible.

Frozen verification-model.md Section 4.2 defines FullTestStatus transitions: not-ready → awaiting-user-decision → authorized → passed|failed. Only awaiting-user-decision and authorized are pre-execution states where full-test can run.

Frozen verification-model.md Section 6 requires: failed status preserved, Policy returns owner-decision/blocked (not action:full-test), owner authorizes corrective Change or cancel, corrective Change resets fullTestStatus to not-ready.

full-test-failed is blocked (not owner-decision) per D1-9: owner has multiple legitimate choices (corrective Change or cancel), so system cannot determine a unique next Action. suggestedOwnerActions lists the options.

D1-13 (full-test eligibility) complements D1-12 (delivery-finalize requires passed): full-test allowed only in pre-execution states, delivery-finalize only in passed, failed → blocked:full-test-failed.
